{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_cf04050c834041d39318fc84","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# NOAA Ensemble Product URL Patterns\n2\t\n3\t## Summary\n4\t\n5\tThis document provides URL patterns and directory structures for accessing NOAA ensemble/statistical products in public archives. Ensemble systems produce multiple forecasts (members) to quantify forecast uncertainty.\n6\t\n7\t**Date:** 2026-07-23  \n8\t**Purpose:** Reference for constructing URLs to access NOAA ensemble model data archives\n9\t\n10\t---\n11\t\n12\t## Overview of NOAA Ensemble Systems\n13\t\n14\t| System | Type | Members | Coverage | Access Method |\n15\t|--------|------|---------|----------|----------------|\n16\t| **GEFS** | Global Medium-Range | 31 (1 control + 30 perturbed) | Global | AWS S3 |\n17\t| **SREF** | Regional Short-Range | 21 | North America | NOMADS |\n18\t| **HREF** | High-Resolution Convective | ~7 | CONUS | NOMADS (discontinued) |\n19\t| **NBM** | Statistical Blend | Deterministic | CONUS | AWS S3 |\n20\t| **NAEFS** | International Joint | 40 | North America | MSC Datamart |\n21\t\n22\t---\n23\t\n24\t## 1. GEFS (Global Ensemble Forecast System)\n25\t\n26\t### Archive Infrastructure\n27\t\n28\t**Archive Platform:** AWS Open Data Registry  \n29\t**Bucket:** `noaa-gefs-pds`  \n30\t**Region:** us-east-1  \n31\t**Access:** Public HTTP/S3 (no authentication required)\n32\t\n33\t### URL Pattern\n34\t\n35\t**AWS S3 Pattern:**\n36\t```\n37\thttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.YYYYMMDD/HH/[product]/[filename]\n38\t```\n39\t\n40\t**Components:**\n41\t- **YYYYMMDD** = Model run date (e.g., `20260723`)\n42\t- **HH** = Cycle hour directory (00, 06, 12, or 18)\n43\t- **[product]** = `pgrb2a` (83 common parameters) or `pgrb2b` (425 less common)\n44\t- **[filename]** = Ensemble member file\n45\t\n46\t### File Naming Conventions\n47\t\n48\t**Control Member (c00):**\n49\t```\n50\tgec00.tXXz.pgrb2aanl      # Analysis\n51\tgec00.tXXz.pgrb2afVV      # Forecast\n52\t```\n53\t\n54\t**Perturbation Members (p01-p30):**\n55\t```\n56\tgepWW.tXXz.pgrb2aanl      # Analysis\n57\tgepWW.tXXz.pgrb2afVV      # Forecast\n58\t```\n59\t\n60\t**Where:**\n61\t- `XX` = Cycle hour from path (00, 06, 12, or 18)\n62\t- `WW` = Ensemble member number (01-20 for some configs, 01-30 for others)\n63\t- `VV` = Forecast hour (00, 06, 12, ..., 384)\n64\t\n65\t### Example URLs\n66\t\n67\t```\n68\t# Control member analysis, July 23, 2026, 00z cycle\n69\thttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.20260723/00/pgrb2a/gec00.t00z.pgrb2aanl\n70\t\n71\t# Perturbation member 05, 12-hour forecast, July 23, 2026, 00z cycle\n72\thttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.20260723/00/pgrb2a/gep05.t00z.pgrb2af012.grib2\n73\t\n74\t# Control member, 48-hour forecast, pgrb2b product\n75\thttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.20260723/12/pgrb2b/gec00.t12z.pgrb2af048.grib2\n76\t\n77\t# Member 30, max range forecast (384 hours)\n78\thttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.20260723/18/pgrb2a/gep30.t18z.pgrb2af384.grib2\n79\t```\n80\t\n81\t### Cycle Schedule and Forecast Range\n82\t\n83\t- **Cycle Frequency:** 4x daily (00z, 06z, 12z, 18z)\n84\t- **Forecast Hours:** 00, 06, 12, 18, ..., 384 (every 6 hours)\n85\t- **Forecast Range:** 0-16 days\n86\t- **Members:** 31 members (control + 30 perturbations)\n87\t\n88\t### Directory Structure Example\n89\t\n90\t```\n91\tgefs.20260723/\n92\t├── 00/\n93\t│   ├── pgrb2a/\n94\t│   │   ├── gec00.t00z.pgrb2aanl\n95\t│   │   ├── gec00.t00z.pgrb2af000.grib2\n96\t│   │   ├── gep01.t00z.pgrb2aanl\n97\t│   │   ├── gep01.t00z.pgrb2af000.grib2\n98\t│   │   ├── gep02.t00z.pgrb2aanl\n99\t│   │   └── ...\n100\t│   └── pgrb2b/\n101\t│       └── ...\n102\t├── 06/\n103\t├── 12/\n104\t└── 18/\n105\t```\n106\t\n107\t---\n108\t\n109\t## 2. SREF (Short Range Ensemble Forecast)\n110\t\n111\t### Archive Infrastructure\n112\t\n113\t**Archive Platform:** NOMADS (NOAA Operational Model Archive and Distribution System)  \n114\t**Access:** HTTP (directory browsing)  \n115\t**Retention:** ~30 days operational, longer via NCEI archive\n116\t\n117\t### URL Pattern\n118\t\n119\t**NOMADS Pattern:**\n120\t```\n121\thttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/sref/prod/sref.YYYYMMDD/HH/[filename]\n122\t```\n123\t\n124\t**Components:**\n125\t- **YYYYMMDD** = Model run date (e.g., `20260723`)\n126\t- **HH** = Cycle hour directory (03, 09, 15, or 21)\n127\t- **[filename]** = Ensemble member file\n128\t\n129\t### File Naming Conventions\n130\t\n131\t**File Pattern:**\n132\t```\n133\tpgrb/sref_[model].tCCz.pgrb212.PP...\n134\t```\n135\t\n136\t**Where:**\n137\t- `model` = Model type (nmm, nmb, em)\n138\t- `CC` = Cycle hour (03, 09, 15, 21)\n139\t- `PP` = Forecast hour (00, 03, 06, ..., 87)\n140\t\n141\t**Ensemble Member Identification:**\n142\tSREF uses 21 members from 4 regional models:\n143\t- **ctl** = Control member (ensemble mean)\n144\t- **g01-g20** = Individual ensemble members\n145\t\n146\t### Example URLs\n147\t\n148\t```\n149\t# SREF directory listing, July 23, 2026, 03z cycle\n150\thttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/sref/prod/sref.20260723/03/\n151\t\n152\t# Individual member files (example patterns):\n153\t# NMM model, 03z cycle, analysis\n154\tpgrb/sref_nmm.t03z.pgrb212.00\n155\t\n156\t# NMB model, 03z cycle, 12-hour forecast\n157\tpgrb/sref_nmb.t03z.pgrb212.12\n158\t\n159\t# EM model, 09z cycle, 36-hour forecast\n160\tpgrb/sref_em.t09z.pgrb212.36\n161\t```\n162\t\n163\t### Cycle Schedule and Forecast Range\n164\t\n165\t- **Cycle Frequency:** 4x daily (03z, 09z, 15z, 21z)\n166\t- **Forecast Hours:** 00, 03, 06, ..., 87 (every 3 hours)\n167\t- **Forecast Range:** 0-87 hours (3.6 days)\n168\t- **Members:** 21 members\n169\t- **Status:** Proposed for termination (July 2025), may be replaced by GEFS\n170\t\n171\t---\n172\t\n173\t## 3. HREF (High Resolution Ensemble Forecast)\n174\t\n175\t### Archive Infrastructure\n176\t\n177\t**Archive Platform:** NOMADS  \n178\t**Access:** HTTP (directory browsing)  \n179\t**Status:** Being discontinued (replaced by REFS)\n180\t\n181\t### URL Pattern\n182\t\n183\t**NOMADS Pattern:**\n184\t```\n185\thttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/href/prod/href.YYYYMMDD/HH/[filename]\n186\t```\n187\t\n188\t**Components:**\n189\t- **YYYYMMDD** = Model run date (e.g., `20260723`)\n190\t- **HH** = Cycle hour directory (00, 06, 12, or 18)\n191\t- **[filename]** = Ensemble member file\n192\t\n193\t### File Naming Conventions\n194\t\n195\t**HREF Members:**\n196\tHREF is a convection-allowing ensemble (~3km resolution) with multiple members:\n197\t- **arw** = Advanced Research WRF\n198\t- **nmm** = Non-hydrostatic Mesoscale Model\n199\t- **nssl** = NSSL configuration\n200\t- Other configurations\n201\t\n202\t**File Pattern:**\n203\t```\n204\thref_[member]_tCCz_fFF_GRIB2\n205\t```\n206\t\n207\t### Example URLs\n208\t\n209\t```\n210\t# HREF directory listing, July 23, 2026, 00z cycle\n211\thttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/href/prod/href.20260723/00/\n212\t\n213\t# ARW member, 00z cycle, analysis\n214\thref_arw_t00z_f00.grib2\n215\t\n216\t# NSSL member, 12z cycle, 6-hour forecast\n217\thref_nssl_t12z_f06.grib2\n218\t```\n219\t\n220\t### Cycle Schedule and Forecast Range\n221\t\n222\t- **Cycle Frequency:** 2x daily (00z, 12z)\n223\t- **Forecast Range:** Typically 0-30 hours\n224\t- **Resolution:** ~3km (convection-allowing)\n225\t- **Status:** Products being discontinued, see SCN26-048\n226\t\n227\t---\n228\t\n229\t## 4. NBM (National Blend of Models)\n230\t\n231\t### Archive Infrastructure\n232\t\n233\t**Archive Platform:** AWS Open Data Registry  \n234\t**Bucket:** `noaa-nbm-grib2-pds`  \n235\t**Region:** us-east-1  \n236\t**Access:** Public HTTP/S3 (no authentication required)\n237\t\n238\t### URL Pattern\n239\t\n240\t**AWS S3 Pattern:**\n241\t```\n242\thttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.YYYYMMDD/HH/core/[filename]\n243\t```\n244\t\n245\t**Components:**\n246\t- **YYYYMMDD** = Model run date (e.g., `20260723`)\n247\t- **HH** = Cycle hour directory (00, 06, 12, or 18)\n248\t- **core** = CONUS core grid product directory\n249\t\n250\t### File Naming Conventions\n251\t\n252\t**Core Files:**\n253\t```\n254\tblend.tCCz.core.fFFF.RR.grib2\n255\t```\n256\t\n257\t**QMD Files:**\n258\t```\n259\tblend.tCCz.qmd.fFFF.RR.grib2\n260\t```\n261\t\n262\t**Where:**\n263\t- `CC` = Cycle hour (00, 06, 12, 18)\n264\t- `FFF` = Three-digit forecast hour (001, 002, ..., 084)\n265\t- `RR` = Region code (co = CONUS, other regions for other products)\n266\t- `qmd` = QMD (quasi-model) output\n267\t\n268\t### Example URLs\n269\t\n270\t```\n271\t# Core blend, July 23, 2026, 00z cycle, 1-hour forecast\n272\thttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20260723/00/core/blend.t00z.core.f001.co.grib2\n273\t\n274\t# Core blend, 12-hour forecast\n275\thttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20260723/00/core/blend.t00z.core.f012.co.grib2\n276\t\n277\t# QMD product, 6z cycle, 24-hour forecast\n278\thttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20260723/06/core/blend.t06z.qmd.f024.co.grib2\n279\t\n280\t# Maximum forecast range (84 hours)\n281\thttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20260723/12/core/blend.t12z.core.f084.co.grib2\n282\t```\n283\t\n284\t### Cycle Schedule and Forecast Range\n285\t\n286\t- **Cycle Frequency:** 4x daily (00z, 06z, 12z, 18z)\n287\t- **Forecast Hours:** 001-084 (hourly forecasts)\n288\t- **Forecast Range:** 0-84 hours (3.5 days)\n289\t- **Update Frequency:** Hourly (updated every hour)\n290\t\n291\t### Important Notes\n292\t\n293\t**NBM is a Deterministic Product:**  \n294\tUnlike GEFS, SREF, or HREF, NBM produces deterministic (single) forecasts that blend inputs from multiple ensemble systems including:\n295\t- GEFS (Global Ensemble Forecast System)\n296\t- HREF (High Resolution Ensemble Forecast) - before discontinuation\n297\t- SREF (Short Range Ensemble Forecast)\n298\t- Canadian ensemble forecasts\n299\t\n300\tNBM does not produce individual ensemble member files; instead, it provides calibrated probabilistic guidance based on ensemble inputs.\n301\t\n302\t---\n303\t\n304\t## 5. NOAA Ensemble Product URL Patterns\n\n## Summary\n\nThis document provides URL patterns and directory structures for accessing NOAA ensemble/statistical products in public archives. Ensemble systems produce multiple forecasts (members) to quantify forecast uncertainty.\n\n**Date:** 2026-07-23  \n**Purpose:** Reference for constructing URLs to access NOAA ensemble model data archives\n\n---\n\n## Overview of NOAA Ensemble Systems\n\n| System | Type | Members | Coverage | Access Method |\n|--------|------|---------|----------|----------------|\n| **GEFS** | Global Medium-Range | 31 (1 control + 30 perturbed) | Global | AWS S3 |\n| **SREF** | Regional Short-Range | 21 | North America | NOMADS |\n| **HREF** | High-Resolution Convective | ~7 | CONUS | NOMADS (discontinued) |\n| **NBM** | Statistical Blend | Deterministic | CONUS | AWS S3 |\n| **NAEFS** | International Joint | 40 | North America | MSC Datamart |\n\n---\n\n## 1. GEFS (Global Ensemble Forecast System)\n\n### Archive Infrastructure\n\n**Archive Platform:** AWS Open Data Registry  \n**Bucket:** `noaa-gefs-pds`  \n**Region:** us-east-1  \n**Access:** Public HTTP/S3 (no authentication required)\n\n### URL Pattern\n\n**AWS S3 Pattern:**\n```\nhttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.YYYYMMDD/HH/[product]/[filename]\n```\n\n**Components:**\n- **YYYYMMDD** = Model run date (e.g., `20260723`)\n- **HH** = Cycle hour directory (00, 06, 12, or 18)\n- **[product]** = `pgrb2a` (83 common parameters) or `pgrb2b` (425 less common)\n- **[filename]** = Ensemble member file\n\n### File Naming Conventions\n\n**Control Member (c00):**\n```\ngec00.tXXz.pgrb2aanl      # Analysis\ngec00.tXXz.pgrb2afVV      # Forecast\n```\n\n**Perturbation Members (p01-p30):**\n```\ngepWW.tXXz.pgrb2aanl      # Analysis\ngepWW.tXXz.pgrb2afVV      # Forecast\n```\n\n**Where:**\n- `XX` = Cycle hour from path (00, 06, 12, or 18)\n- `WW` = Ensemble member number (01-20 for some configs, 01-30 for others)\n- `VV` = Forecast hour (00, 06, 12, ..., 384)\n\n### Example URLs\n\n```\n# Control member analysis, July 23, 2026, 00z cycle\nhttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.20260723/00/pgrb2a/gec00.t00z.pgrb2aanl\n\n# Perturbation member 05, 12-hour forecast, July 23, 2026, 00z cycle\nhttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.20260723/00/pgrb2a/gep05.t00z.pgrb2af012.grib2\n\n# Control member, 48-hour forecast, pgrb2b product\nhttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.20260723/12/pgrb2b/gec00.t12z.pgrb2af048.grib2\n\n# Member 30, max range forecast (384 hours)\nhttps://noaa-gefs-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gefs.20260723/18/pgrb2a/gep30.t18z.pgrb2af384.grib2\n```\n\n### Cycle Schedule and Forecast Range\n\n- **Cycle Frequency:** 4x daily (00z, 06z, 12z, 18z)\n- **Forecast Hours:** 00, 06, 12, 18, ..., 384 (every 6 hours)\n- **Forecast Range:** 0-16 days\n- **Members:** 31 members (control + 30 perturbations)\n\n### Directory Structure Example\n\n```\ngefs.20260723/\n├── 00/\n│   ├── pgrb2a/\n│   │   ├── gec00.t00z.pgrb2aanl\n│   │   ├── gec00.t00z.pgrb2af000.grib2\n│   │   ├── gep01.t00z.pgrb2aanl\n│   │   ├── gep01.t00z.pgrb2af000.grib2\n│   │   ├── gep02.t00z.pgrb2aanl\n│   │   └── ...\n│   └── pgrb2b/\n│       └── ...\n├── 06/\n├── 12/\n└── 18/\n```\n\n---\n\n## 2. SREF (Short Range Ensemble Forecast)\n\n### Archive Infrastructure\n\n**Archive Platform:** NOMADS (NOAA Operational Model Archive and Distribution System)  \n**Access:** HTTP (directory browsing)  \n**Retention:** ~30 days operational, longer via NCEI archive\n\n### URL Pattern\n\n**NOMADS Pattern:**\n```\nhttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/sref/prod/sref.YYYYMMDD/HH/[filename]\n```\n\n**Components:**\n- **YYYYMMDD** = Model run date (e.g., `20260723`)\n- **HH** = Cycle hour directory (03, 09, 15, or 21)\n- **[filename]** = Ensemble member file\n\n### File Naming Conventions\n\n**File Pattern:**\n```\npgrb/sref_[model].tCCz.pgrb212.PP...\n```\n\n**Where:**\n- `model` = Model type (nmm, nmb, em)\n- `CC` = Cycle hour (03, 09, 15, 21)\n- `PP` = Forecast hour (00, 03, 06, ..., 87)\n\n**Ensemble Member Identification:**\nSREF uses 21 members from 4 regional models:\n- **ctl** = Control member (ensemble mean)\n- **g01-g20** = Individual ensemble members\n\n### Example URLs\n\n```\n# SREF directory listing, July 23, 2026, 03z cycle\nhttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/sref/prod/sref.20260723/03/\n\n# Individual member files (example patterns):\n# NMM model, 03z cycle, analysis\npgrb/sref_nmm.t03z.pgrb212.00\n\n# NMB model, 03z cycle, 12-hour forecast\npgrb/sref_nmb.t03z.pgrb212.12\n\n# EM model, 09z cycle, 36-hour forecast\npgrb/sref_em.t09z.pgrb212.36\n```\n\n### Cycle Schedule and Forecast Range\n\n- **Cycle Frequency:** 4x daily (03z, 09z, 15z, 21z)\n- **Forecast Hours:** 00, 03, 06, ..., 87 (every 3 hours)\n- **Forecast Range:** 0-87 hours (3.6 days)\n- **Members:** 21 members\n- **Status:** Proposed for termination (July 2025), may be replaced by GEFS\n\n---\n\n## 3. HREF (High Resolution Ensemble Forecast)\n\n### Archive Infrastructure\n\n**Archive Platform:** NOMADS  \n**Access:** HTTP (directory browsing)  \n**Status:** Being discontinued (replaced by REFS)\n\n### URL Pattern\n\n**NOMADS Pattern:**\n```\nhttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/href/prod/href.YYYYMMDD/HH/[filename]\n```\n\n**Components:**\n- **YYYYMMDD** = Model run date (e.g., `20260723`)\n- **HH** = Cycle hour directory (00, 06, 12, or 18)\n- **[filename]** = Ensemble member file\n\n### File Naming Conventions\n\n**HREF Members:**\nHREF is a convection-allowing ensemble (~3km resolution) with multiple members:\n- **arw** = Advanced Research WRF\n- **nmm** = Non-hydrostatic Mesoscale Model\n- **nssl** = NSSL configuration\n- Other configurations\n\n**File Pattern:**\n```\nhref_[member]_tCCz_fFF_GRIB2\n```\n\n### Example URLs\n\n```\n# HREF directory listing, July 23, 2026, 00z cycle\nhttps://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/href/prod/href.20260723/00/\n\n# ARW member, 00z cycle, analysis\nhref_arw_t00z_f00.grib2\n\n# NSSL member, 12z cycle, 6-hour forecast\nhref_nssl_t12z_f06.grib2\n```\n\n### Cycle Schedule and Forecast Range\n\n- **Cycle Frequency:** 2x daily (00z, 12z)\n- **Forecast Range:** Typically 0-30 hours\n- **Resolution:** ~3km (convection-allowing)\n- **Status:** Products being discontinued, see SCN26-048\n\n---\n\n## 4. NBM (National Blend of Models)\n\n### Archive Infrastructure\n\n**Archive Platform:** AWS Open Data Registry  \n**Bucket:** `noaa-nbm-grib2-pds`  \n**Region:** us-east-1  \n**Access:** Public HTTP/S3 (no authentication required)\n\n### URL Pattern\n\n**AWS S3 Pattern:**\n```\nhttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.YYYYMMDD/HH/core/[filename]\n```\n\n**Components:**\n- **YYYYMMDD** = Model run date (e.g., `20260723`)\n- **HH** = Cycle hour directory (00, 06, 12, or 18)\n- **core** = CONUS core grid product directory\n\n### File Naming Conventions\n\n**Core Files:**\n```\nblend.tCCz.core.fFFF.RR.grib2\n```\n\n**QMD Files:**\n```\nblend.tCCz.qmd.fFFF.RR.grib2\n```\n\n**Where:**\n- `CC` = Cycle hour (00, 06, 12, 18)\n- `FFF` = Three-digit forecast hour (001, 002, ..., 084)\n- `RR` = Region code (co = CONUS, other regions for other products)\n- `qmd` = QMD (quasi-model) output\n\n### Example URLs\n\n```\n# Core blend, July 23, 2026, 00z cycle, 1-hour forecast\nhttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20260723/00/core/blend.t00z.core.f001.co.grib2\n\n# Core blend, 12-hour forecast\nhttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20260723/00/core/blend.t00z.core.f012.co.grib2\n\n# QMD product, 6z cycle, 24-hour forecast\nhttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20260723/06/core/blend.t06z.qmd.f024.co.grib2\n\n# Maximum forecast range (84 hours)\nhttps://noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/blend.20260723/12/core/blend.t12z.core.f084.co.grib2\n```\n\n### Cycle Schedule and Forecast Range\n\n- **Cycle Frequency:** 4x daily (00z, 06z, 12z, 18z)\n- **Forecast Hours:** 001-084 (hourly forecasts)\n- **Forecast Range:** 0-84 hours (3.5 days)\n- **Update Frequency:** Hourly (updated every hour)\n\n### Important Notes\n\n**NBM is a Deterministic Product:**  \nUnlike GEFS, SREF, or HREF, NBM produces deterministic (single) forecasts that blend inputs from multiple ensemble systems including:\n- GEFS (Global Ensemble Forecast System)\n- HREF (High Resolution Ensemble Forecast) - before discontinuation\n- SREF (Short Range Ensemble Forecast)\n- Canadian ensemble forecasts\n\nNBM does not produce individual ensemble member files; instead, it provides calibrated probabilistic guidance based on ensemble inputs.\n\n---\n\n## 5. NAEFS (North American Ensemble Forecast System)\n\n### Archive Infrastructure\n\n**Archive Platform:** MSC Datamart (Meteorological Service of Canada)  \n**Access:** HTTP via weather.gc.ca\n\n### URL Pattern\n\n**MSC Datamart Pattern:**\n```\nhttps://[server].weather.gc.ca/ensemble/naefs/[product]/[path]\n```\n\n**Components:**\n- NAEFS is a joint MSC/NOAA project combining ensembles from both agencies\n- Data accessible through MSC's Datamart server\n- Specific file naming patterns vary by product type\n\n### Product Types\n\n- Temperature Anomaly Forecast (Day 8-14)\n- EPSgrams (ensemble time series)\n- Standard Deviation/Mean Charts\n- Probability maps\n\n### Documentation\n\n**Primary Documentation:**\n- [MSC Open Data Documentation](https://eccc-msc.github.io/open-data/msc-data/nwp_naefs/readme_naefs_en/)\n- [CPC NAEFS Products](https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/products/predictions/short_range/NAEFS/)\n\n**Note:** Detailed URL patterns for individual ensemble member files are not as well-documented as GEFS or SREF.\n\n---\n\n## GEFS Reforecast Data (Historical Archive)\n\n### Archive Infrastructure\n\n**Bucket:** `noaa-gefs-retrospective.s3.amazonaws.com`  \n**Access:** Public S3 (no authentication required)\n\n### Description\n\nGEFSv12 reforecast data spanning 2000-2019 is available on AWS. This is a research-quality dataset for model evaluation and calibration.\n\n### Access\n\n**S3 Bucket:**\n```\ns3://noaa-gefs-retrospective/\n```\n\n**Documentation:**\n- Description: `https://noaa-gefs-retrospective.s3.amazonaws.com/Description_of_reforecast_data.pdf`\n- Access via NOAA's PSL Reforecast V2 Project\n\n**Note:** Specific file naming conventions for reforecast data are documented in the PDF description available at the bucket root.\n\n---\n\n## Comparison Table: Ensemble System Characteristics\n\n| System | Access | Cycle Times | Members | Forecast Range | File Extension | URL Structure |\n|--------|--------|-------------|---------|----------------|----------------|----------------|\n| **GEFS** | AWS S3 | 00z, 06z, 12z, 18z | 31 | 0-384h (16d) | .grib2 | `/gefs.YYYYMMDD/HH/pgrb2[a|b]/` |\n| **SREF** | NOMADS | 03z, 09z, 15z, 21z | 21 | 0-87h | varies | `/sref.YYYYMMDD/HH/` |\n| **HREF** | NOMADS | 00z, 12z | ~7 | 0-30h | .grib2 | `/href.YYYYMMDD/HH/` |\n| **NBM** | AWS S3 | 00z, 06z, 12z, 18z | 1 (blend) | 0-84h | .grib2 | `/blend.YYYYMMDD/HH/core/` |\n| **NAEFS** | MSC | Varies | 40 | Varies | Varies | `/ensemble/naefs/` |\n\n---\n\n## Ensemble Member Identification Patterns\n\n| System | Control Member | Perturbed Members | Naming Pattern |\n|--------|---------------|-------------------|----------------|\n| **GEFS** | `gec00` | `gep01`-`gep30` | Prefix + 2-digit number |\n| **SREF** | `ctl` | `g01`-`g20` | Member-specific codes |\n| **HREF** | Varies by model | `arw`, `nmm`, `nssl`, etc. | Model/configuration names |\n| **NBM** | N/A (deterministic) | N/A | N/A (blended product) |\n\n---\n\n## Access Patterns and Rate Limits\n\n### AWS S3 Access (GEFS, NBM)\n\n- **Authentication:** None required (public open data)\n- Browsing:** Supported\n\n### Best Practices\n\n1. **For recent cycles (< 30 days):** Use NOMADS or AWS S3\n2. **For historical research:** Use NCEI archive or GEFS reforecast data\n3. **For Description\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nThe Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS), previously known as the GFS Global ENSemble (GENS), is a weather forecast model made up of 21 separate forecasts, or ensemble members. The National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) started the GEFS to address the nature of uncertainty in weather observations, which is used to initialize weather forecast models. The GEFS attempts to quantify the amount of uncertainty in a forecast by generating an ensemble of multiple forecasts, each minutely different, or perturbed, from the original observations. With global coverage, GEFS is produced four times a day with weather forecasts going out to 16 days.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#### Update Frequency\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n4 times a day, every 6 hours starting at midnight.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n#### License\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nNOAA data disseminated through NODD are open to the public and can be used as desired.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nNOAA makes data openly available to ensure maximum use of our data, and to spur and encourage exploration and innovation throughout the industry.
